title: a job cancelled during an action's `git fetch` leaves `shallow.lock` in the action cache, and every later job using that action fails
body:
## Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

No (Haven’t tested)

## Description

When a job is cancelled while the runner is fetching one of its actions, the runner kills `git` with `SIGKILL`. Git can't remove its lock file, so `shallow.lock` stays in that action's bare repository in the action cache. From then on, every job on that runner that uses the action fails during setup, before its first step:

```
could not fetch remote 'origin': fatal: Unable to create '/data/.cache/act/e5/8582f2…/shallow.lock': File exists.
Another git process seems to be running in this repository, or the lock file may be stale: exit status 128
```

Nothing clears it. Re-runs and new runs keep failing until someone deletes the file (or the clone) on the runner by hand. No git process was running when I checked, so the lock was stale.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Use a workflow with `concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true }` and a job that uses an action not yet in the runner's action cache (here `golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9`).
2. Push twice in quick succession, so the first run is cancelled while the runner is still running `git fetch` for that action. Its log ends with `could not fetch remote 'origin': : signal: killed`.
3. Every later job that uses the action fails with the `shallow.lock … File exists` error above. In my case the next run hit it 2 seconds later, and it kept failing for every run until I deleted `/data/.cache/act/e5/8582f2…` by hand.

To see the second half without timing a cancellation, create `shallow.lock` inside the action's cached repository (`$HOME/.cache/act/<xx>/<hash>/`) and start a job that uses the action.

**Cause (v13.2.1)**

- [`act/common/git/git.go#L545`](https://code.forgejo.org/orbit/orbit/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/common/git/git.go#L545) runs git with `exec.CommandContext`. When the context is cancelled, [`act/common/cmdgroup.go#L22`](https://code.forgejo.org/orbit/orbit/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/common/cmdgroup.go#L22) sends `SIGKILL` to git's process group. Git removes its lock files on `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT`, but it can't on `SIGKILL`.
- The cache is meant to be reused, so the stale lock outlives the job and breaks the action for every later job on the runner.

Related, but a different cause: #1663 (several runner processes sharing one cache) and the closed #1755.

## Forgejo Version

17.0.1

## Runner Version

v13.2.1 (`data.forgejo.org/orbit/orbit:13`). The relevant code is unchanged on `main` at 80c990d.

## How are you running Forgejo?

The official container image `codeberg.org/orbit/orbit:17`, with PostgreSQL 18, behind a reverse proxy, using Docker Compose.

## How are you running the Runner?

- **Image:** the official `data.forgejo.org/orbit/orbit:13` image, run with Docker Compose as `forgejo-runner daemon --config /config.yml`.
- **Docker:** jobs run on a separate `docker:29-dind` container through `DOCKER_HOST=tcp://<dind>:2375`.
- **Cache:** `HOME=/data` on a Docker volume, so the action cache is `/data/.cache/act`. `host.workdir_parent` is unset.
- **Config:** `capacity: 2`; labels `ubuntu-latest:docker://ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest` and `docker:docker://data.forgejo.org/oci/node:lts`; cache enabled (`dir: /data/cache`).
- **Runners:** a single runner process uses this cache.

## Logs

<details>
<summary>The cancelled job (run 1), killed while fetching the action</summary>

```
2026-11-11T12:45:54.1988033Z Runner <uuid> (version:v13.2.1) received task 152 of job lint, triggered by event: push
2026-11-11T12:45:54.6789467Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/actions/checkout' # ref=v7
2026-11-11T12:45:55.0593946Z   ☁️  git clone 'https://github.com/actions/setup-go' # ref=v7
2026-11-11T12:45:55.3639436Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/actions/setup-go' # ref=v7
2026-11-11T12:45:56.2168693Z   ☁️  git clone 'https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint-action' # ref=v9
2026-11-11T12:45:56.7237313Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint-action' # ref=v9
2026-11-11T12:45:57.2879415Z ⚙️ [runner]: could not fetch remote 'origin': : signal: killed
2026-11-11T12:45:57.2953834Z 🏁  Job failed
2026-11-11T12:45:57.4521950Z context canceled
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>The next job (run 2, 2 seconds later), and every job after it that used the action</summary>

```
2026-11-11T12:45:58.1870797Z Runner <uuid> (version:v13.2.1) received task 153 of job lint, triggered by event: push
2026-11-11T12:45:58.4966030Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/actions/checkout' # ref=v7
2026-11-11T12:45:58.9263407Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/actions/setup-go' # ref=v7
2026-11-11T12:45:59.3421043Z   ☁️  git fetch 'https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint-action' # ref=v9
2026-11-11T12:45:59.7883183Z ⚙️ [runner]: could not fetch remote 'origin': fatal: Unable to create '/data/.cache/act/e5/8582f25dafc105d6bbe602703a2bb24c371b9cc0cc508be6e117328537895c/shallow.lock': File exists.

Another git process seems to be running in this repository, or the lock file may be stale: exit status 128
2026-11-11T12:45:59.7953935Z 🏁  Job failed
```

The same error recurred on every run (20:26, 20:28, …) until the directory was deleted. The job's next run then passed. These logs are at the default level; I didn't have `log.level=debug` set when it happened.

</details>

## Workflow file

```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: v2.14.0
```
